title: In an escape: html output every value that {{ }}, echo and cycle write is escaped, each of its five characters, and the template's text, raw, embed and provenance are not; a value whose last filter is safe, escape, h, escape_once or json_script, and a capture made there, is written as it is, and a later filter drops that; a partial is escaped as the output is; and an escape: none output, given or defaulted, escapes nothing
